6531223.name: Chabad of Babcock Ranch - Charlotte County
6531223.note: CrownHeights.info, 4 Dec 2024 ('Chabad Responds to Tragedy by Expanding Global Outreach: 100 New Centers To Be Established'): Keren Hashluchim seed funding 'for one hundred new Chabad centers in underserved areas'; among 'The Fifty New Shluchim': 'Rabbi Mendel and Malky Jacobson at Chabad of Babcock Ranch, FL' (a new community Chabad House). Its chabad.org listing went up 1 Oct 2024; IRS (ProPublica): 'Chabad Of Babcock Ranch - Charlotte County Inc', care of Menachem Mendel Jacobson, exempt from 2025-06.

4951069.name: Ckids Gan Israel Florida
4951069.note: COLlive, 10 June 2020 ('New "Gan Izzy Overnight Camp" to Open in Florida'): 'the brand new CKids Gan Israel is launching a magnificent ten-day camp session for boys from grades four to seven', a Merkos 302 pilot overnight camp in South Florida, hosted that year at Camp Gan Israel Florida's campsite in Lake Worth; 'The professional and experienced staff, led by directors Rabbi Levi and Chaya Plotkin'. COLlive, 14 Jan 2021: Rabbi Levi Plotkin 'is camp director alongside his wife Chaya'. Its chabad.org listing went up 6 Jan 2021.
